prompts.builtIn.textGeneration.name: Text card generation
prompts.builtIn.director.description: A director workflow for requirements, story, image assets and image-to-video creation.

prompts.builtIn.characterViews.descripti: Create a front half-body portrait and full-body front, side and back views of the same character from a source image, on a 16:9 white design sheet with soft lighting. Subject instructions are appended to the prompt; each new task freezes the current configuration.
prompts.builtIn.faceViews.description: Create front, three-quarter and profile views of the same head and shoulders from a source image. Subject instructions are appended to the prompt; each new task freezes the current configuration.
prompts.builtIn.propViews.description: Create front, side and back orthographic views of the same prop from a source image. Subject instructions are appended to the prompt; each new task freezes the current configuration.

prompts.builtIn.reversePrompt.descriptio: Infer a reusable image-generation prompt from the selected image version. Each run freezes the current instructions and leaves the media draft unchanged.
prompts.builtIn.videoOptimization.descri: Refine a video draft prompt, optionally using a pinned Skill version as a writing method. Apply the result after user confirmation.
skills.builtin.visualAssets.title: Visual asset design · short-drama-assets
skills.builtin.visualAssets.description: Extract characters, looks, locations, props and continuity states from script cards. Build visual design cards to plan reusable assets, variants, period details and continuity across episodes.
skills.builtin.storyDevelopment.title: Story development · short-drama-develop
skills.builtin.storyDevelopment.descript: Develop ideas, source analyses or episode script cards into creative briefs, adaptation plans, story engines and episode outlines. Set a dramatic direction, develop a short drama or continue an existing series.
skills.builtin.imagePrompts.title: Image prompts · short-drama-image-prompts
skills.builtin.imagePrompts.description: Write image prompt cards from visual designs and actual reference images. Plan character, location and prop sheets, state variants, style frames or local edits; generation uses the existing media approval flow.
skills.builtin.sourceAnalysis.title: Source novel analysis · short-drama-novel-analyze
skills.builtin.sourceAnalysis.descriptio: Analyze linked novels or long text cards. Build chapter indexes, adaptation assessments, chapter analyses, coverage checks and episode candidates; continue from a saved progress card when needed.
skills.builtin.creativeReview.title: Creative review · short-drama-review
skills.builtin.creativeReview.descriptio: Review linked source analyses, stories, scripts, visual designs, storyboards or prompt cards. Produce review cards with precise sources and revision suggestions, retain open questions and leave the source unchanged.
skills.builtin.storyboards.title: Storyboards and keyframes · short-drama-storyboard
skills.builtin.storyboards.description: Turn scripts and visual designs into storyboard, scene staging and keyframe prompt cards. Design shots, compare directing approaches and check camera axes, blocking and continuity between shots.
skills.builtin.videoPrompts.title: Video prompts · short-drama-video-prompts
skills.builtin.videoPrompts.description: Write video action, performance, camera movement and music direction cards from storyboards, keyframes and actual media cards. Prepare generation prompts or revise motion limits; generation uses existing capability proposals.
skills.builtin.episodeScripts.title: Episode scripts · short-drama-write
skills.builtin.episodeScripts.descriptio: Write and revise short dramas or comic dramas from linked outlines, episode plans or scripts. Draft episodes, revise dialogue and scenes, clean up source formatting or continue across scenes, saving the result as script cards.
skills.builtin.h3Prompts.title: H3 prompt writing · h3-prompt-writing
skills.builtin.h3Prompts.description: Write and revise MiniMax H3 text-to-video, keyframe and multimodal reference prompts with audiovisual timelines and precise reference tags. This prepares prompts; it does not mean the corresponding model or input mode is connected.
skills.builtin.productAds.title: Minimalist product ads · minimalist-product-ad-generator
skills.builtin.productAds.description: Turn product reference images and selling points into minimalist ad plans. Plan the featured product, separate reference images, single-line copy and precise timing for product showcases or launches.
skills.builtin.animatedShorts.title: 3D animated shorts · 3d-animation-short-generator
skills.builtin.animatedShorts.descriptio: Develop story ideas into stylized 3D short-film briefs, character and location cards, six-column shot lists and second-by-second storyboards. Keep identity, space, performance and sound consistent.
skills.builtin.brandVideos.title: Brand promo videos · brand-promo-video-generator
skills.builtin.brandVideos.description: Organize brand facts and user materials, choose a product narrative, and plan precise timing, calls to action and sound. Build a reviewable promo-video plan and advance production through the existing approval flow.
skills.builtin.musicVideos.title: Music videos and lyric text · music-video-subtitle-generator
skills.builtin.musicVideos.description: Plan music videos, lyrics placed within the scene, shot timelines and transitions from user songs, lyrics and visual references. Maintain the main audio track and a consistent character style.
skills.builtin.gameIntros.title: Co-op game intros · co-op-game-intro-generator
skills.builtin.gameIntros.description: Design an initial approval image around two characters, player names and a menu layout. Then plan main-menu interactions and the opening video for a game concept.
skills.builtin.collageExplainers.title: Paper collage explainers · paper-collage-explainer-generator
skills.builtin.collageExplainers.descrip: Turn ideas, knowledge or spoken scripts into halftone paper-collage visual metaphors. Plan still frames, stop-motion assembly and tactile sound effects; music, narration and subtitles are omitted by default.
skills.builtin.papercraftExplainers.desc: Explain science or other topics with paper puppets, layered paper sculptures, pop-up books and miniature sets. Plan characters, props, visual previews, storyboards, sound and production prompts.
skills.builtin.handdrawnVideo.title: Hand-drawn and live-action video · handdrawn-live-video-generator
skills.builtin.handdrawnVideo.descriptio: Build hand-drawn glowing animation prompts around live-action spaces, hand contact, continuous transformations and slightly delayed tracking shots. Suited to gentle creative videos in a single scene.
